answer: Each identity locks 60 POA escrow on a public ledge: a registry of its deposit, referrer, and an ivory seal. The referral graph ties newcomers to sponsors, so 100 fakes trace to one funder. Any peer may dispute a suspect; if upheld, the deposit is slashed and the sponsor loses the same. Faking 100 costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA; the delta to the 40 POA one honest newcomer earns makes the attack a loss. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted.
